facts.fact: In a Lincoln Institute study of large-city finances, a one standard deviation increase in revenue diversification, equal to 13 percentage points, was associated with a 7.2% increase in general revenue.

facts.fact: In the Lincoln Institute study, cities moving from the 25th to the 75th percentile of diversification (51% to 69%) had about 10% higher revenue over a 12-year period.
